mapper.insert: insert into t_knowledge_base_connection (id, connector_id, name, icon, status, description, params, project_id, domain_id, domain_name, create_user_id, create_user_name, create_time, workspace_id, update_user_id, update_user_name, update_time, used_abilities) values (#{connection.id}, #{connection.connectorId}, #{connection.name}, #{connection.icon}, #{connection.status}, #{connection.description}, #{connection.params,typeHandler=com.openjiuwen.studio.agent.agentbase.mapper.handler.KnowledgeBaseConnectionParamListHandler}, #{connection.projectId}, #{connection.domainId}, #{connection.domainName}, #{connection.createdUserId}, #{connection.createdUserName}, #{connection.createTime}, #{connection.workspaceId}, #{connection.updateUserId}, #{connection.updateUserName}, #{connection.updateTime}, #{connection.usedAbilities})

mapper.select: select connection_t.id, connection_t.name, connection_t.icon, connection_t.status, connection_t.description, connection_t.connector_id, connection_t.params, connection_t.project_id, connection_t.domain_id, connection_t.domain_name, connection_t.create_user_id, connection_t.create_user_name, connection_t.create_time, connection_t.workspace_id, connection_t.update_user_id, connection_t.update_user_name, connection_t.update_time, connection_t.used_abilities, connector_t.name as connector_name from t_knowledge_base_connection connection_t INNER JOIN t_knowledge_base_connector connector_t ON connection_t.connector_id = connector_t.id where connection_t.id = #{id} and connection_t.workspace_id = #{workspace_id} and connection_t.project_id = #{project_id}
